newsitem.title: USA: Three Rivers says receives 91.9 pct of SMT shares.
newsitem.headline: Three Rivers says receives 91.9 pct of SMT shares.

text.p: Three River Holding Corp said on Tuesday its wholly owned subsidiary, Three Rivers Acquisition Corp, got 91.9 percent of the outstanding shares in its completed $11.75 per share cash tender offer for all of common shares of SMT Health Services Inc.

The company said the depositary for the offer has informed Three Rivers Acquisition that 5,280,297 shares have been validly tendered and not withdrawn prior to the expiration of the offer, including 2,841 shares tendered pursuant to notice of guaranteed delivery procedures.
All shares validly tendered and not withdrawn have been accepted for payment of $11.75 per share in cash.

As previously announced, the remaining shares of SMT Health Services will be converted into the right to receive $11.75 per share in cash in a merger between SMT Health Services and Three Rivers Acquisition.
The company expects to consumate the merger in September 1997.
SMT Health through its fleet of 18 mobile MRI units, provides diagnostic imaging services to healthcare providers in Pennsylvania, West Virginia, North Carolina, Ohio, Virginia and Kentucky.
Three Rivers Holding Corp is an affiliate of Apollo Management LP.
As previously reported, Apollo plans to merge SMT with Alliance Imaging Inc. Allianc Imaging entered into a definitive agreement to acquire Newport Investment LLC, another Apollo affiliate.
